title: Consubstantial
summary: CONSUBSTANTIAL, adjective [Latin See Substance.] 1. Having the same substance or essence; co-essential. The orthodox believe the Son to be consubstantial with the Father. 2. Of the same kind or nature

inlines.v: CONSUBSTANTIAL, adjective [Latin See Substance.] 1. Having the same substance or essence; co-essential. The orthodox believe the Son to be consubstantial with the Father. 2. Of the same kind or nature. It continueth a body consubstantial with ours.
